preconditions.description: The number of courses n is non-negative.
Each prerequisite pair is a list of exactly two integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= pair[0] < n and 0 <= pair[1] < n for pair in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each course number in a prerequisite pair is within the range [0, n-1].
There are no duplicate prerequisite pairs.

postconditions.expression: result == (no cycles in the directed graph formed by prerequisites)
postconditions.description: The function returns True if it is possible to finish all courses, otherwise False.
